body: Nutella Cookie Pie 🍪🍫 🇫🇷 FR / ENG 🇬🇧 Ingrédients 🗒️ 220g de beurre mou 150g de cassonade 60g de sucre en poudre 1 œuf 1 jaune d’œuf 2 cas d’arôme vanille 310g de farine Une bonne pincée de sel 1 cac de levure chimique 150g de pépites de chocolat au lait 260g de Nutella Préparation 👩🏻‍🍳 1. Mélangez le beurre mou avec la cassonade et le sucre en poudre jusqu’à obtenir un mélange crémeux. 3. Ajoutez l’œuf, le jaune d’œuf et l’arôme vanille, puis battez légèrement au batteur électrique. 4. Ajoutez la farine, le sel et la levure chimique, puis mélangez délicatement, sans trop travailler la pâte. 5. Incorporez 100g de pépites de chocolat au lait. 6. Placez la pâte au réfrigérateur pendant 1 heure. 7. Pendant ce temps, étalez les 260g de Nutella en formant un disque, puis placez-le au congélateur pendant environ 1 heure, jusqu’à ce qu’il soit bien ferme. 8. Dans un moule de 18cm, étalez une partie de la pâte à cookie et créez un petit puits au centre. 9. Déposez le disque de Nutella congelé au centre, puis recouvrez-le complètement avec le reste de pâte à cookie afin de bien enfermer le Nutella à l’intérieur. 10. Parsemez les 50g de pépites de chocolat restants sur le dessus. 11. Enfournez dans un four préchauffé à 175°C pendant 30 à 35 minutes. 12. Laissez complètement refroidir avant de déguster afin que le cookie pie se raffermisse tout en gardant son cœur fondant. Bon appétit 🍪🍫🤎 Nutella Cookie Pie 🍪🍫 🇬🇧 Ingredients 🗒️ 220g softened butter 150g brown sugar 60g granulated sugar 1 egg 1 egg yolk 2 tbsp vanilla extract 310g flour A generous pinch of salt 1 tsp baking powder 150g milk chocolate chips 260g Nutella Preparation 👩🏻‍🍳 1. Mix the softened butter with the brown sugar and granulated sugar until creamy. 2. Add the egg, egg yolk and vanilla extract, then beat briefly with an electric mixer. 3. Add the flour, salt and baking powder, then gently mix until just combined. Do not overmix the dough. 4. Fold in 100g of the milk chocolate chips. 5. Refrigerate the cookie dough for 1 hour. 6. In the meantime, spread the 260g of Nutella into a disc and freeze for about 1 hour, until firm. 7. In an 18cm baking pan, spread some of the cookie dough and create a small well in the center. 8. Place the frozen Nutella disc in the center, then completely cover it with the remaining cookie dough to seal the Nutella inside. 9. Sprinkle the remaining 50g of chocolate chips on top. 10. Bake in a preheated oven at 175°C (350°F) for 30-35 minutes. 11. Let it cool completely before serving so the cookie pie can set while keeping its gooey Nutella center. Enjoy! 🍪🍫🤎 #recettefacile #recettefacileetrapide #nutellacookiepie #cookiepie #automne

body: Teheran - Sebuah rekaman yang beredar luas memperlihatkan momen menegangkan ketika formasi jet tempur modern terganggu oleh perubahan tekanan udara yang tiba-tiba, memaksa pilot melakukan koreksi cepat untuk menghindari risiko tabrakan di udara. Dalam video tersebut, beberapa unit F-35 Lightning II terlihat terbang dalam formasi rapat pada ketinggian relatif rendah — sebuah manuver yang menuntut presisi tinggi dan koordinasi sempurna. Namun dalam hitungan detik, formasi itu tampak goyah ketika gelombang kejut atmosfer mengganggu kestabilan pesawat. Para analis penerbangan menyebut fenomena ini kemungkinan berkaitan dengan perubahan tekanan udara mendadak, yang dapat disebabkan oleh berbagai faktor, termasuk interaksi aliran udara antar pesawat, turbulensi ekstrem, atau bahkan gelombang kejut dari aktivitas supersonik di sekitar area tersebut. “Dalam formasi yang sangat rapat, sedikit gangguan saja bisa berdampak besar,” kata seorang mantan pilot militer. “Perubahan tekanan yang tiba-tiba dapat menggeser posisi pesawat dalam sepersekian detik.” Rekaman menunjukkan bagaimana jet-jet tersebut tampak bergeser dari posisi semula, dengan jarak antar pesawat menyempit secara berbahaya sebelum pilot berhasil mengembalikan kendali. Tidak ada laporan resmi mengenai insiden tersebut, termasuk lokasi atau apakah terjadi kerusakan. Fenomena seperti ini menyoroti kompleksitas penerbangan militer modern, di mana teknologi canggih harus berhadapan dengan variabel lingkungan yang tidak selalu dapat diprediksi. Bahkan dengan sistem kontrol penerbangan yang canggih, pilot tetap menjadi faktor kunci dalam menjaga keselamatan. Formasi udara, terutama yang melibatkan pesawat seperti F-35 Lightning II, sering digunakan dalam latihan maupun operasi sebagai bagian dari strategi taktis. Namun, seperti yang ditunjukkan dalam rekaman tersebut, margin kesalahan di udara bisa sangat tipis. Bagi para pilot, momen seperti ini bukan sekadar gangguan — melainkan ujian refleks, pelatihan, dan ketenangan di bawah tekanan ekstrem. Dalam dunia penerbangan militer, di mana kecepatan tinggi bertemu dengan ketidakpastian alam, kendali sering kali bergantung pada keputusan yang diambil dalam hitungan detik. #rudal #iran #israel #telaviv #fyp

body: Axios reported tonight that the Pentagon instructed US Central Command several days ago to conclude preparations for resuming major combat operations in Iran. The report cites US officials. Sources said a renewed campaign would include heavy bombing of Iranian energy, infrastructure and nuclear targets, most likely with US and Israeli forces working together. More from the report. President Trump spoke with Israel's prime minister today, their 2nd call in days. On Friday his national security team met at Camp David. An Israeli official told Axios part of that meeting covered resuming the war. The Secretary of State said it was about long-term foreign policy planning. Israeli officials also warned that Iran could strike first. What it does not say matters just as much. There is no strike date, and Axios says the president has not made a final decision. A Pentagon official said the department's job is to develop and present military options. One Israeli official called the odds of action in the next few weeks not high, but not ruled out. Talks have made no progress, and Qatari mediators are waiting for Iran's answer to a US counterproposal. author: theviralbreif
body: What happens when the infrastructure behind everyday digital life becomes part of a threat of war? Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council, has warned that another conflict could involve the destruction of cables, data centers, AI facilities, and other sites across the region. He also signaled a broader Iranian response. The statement describes a possible future escalation. It does not establish that attacks on those facilities have occurred, or that every threatened target could actually be reached. Still, the potential consequences deserve serious scrutiny. Disruption to communications and computing infrastructure could create problems beyond the battlefield, affecting services that communities and businesses depend on. When officials threaten a wider confrontation, the public deserves to understand what is at risk—and what efforts are being made to prevent it. How should regional governments respond to threats against infrastructure with such broad civilian importance? Can negotiations reduce the danger, or will competing threats make an agreement harder? Would this warning make you more concerned about renewed war? What steps should leaders take now to keep that scenario from becoming reality?
